about_the_game:
FiresOut! is a chaotic couch co-op firefighting game for up to four players where teamwork makes the dream work... or total disaster! You and your friends dive right into the burning neighborhood working together to extinguish ever spreading flames, rescue trapped victims, and overcome unpredictable environmental hazards all while dodging fiery projectiles from the fire monsters. Every mission pushes the team to communicate, strategize, and adapt quickly with chaos at every corner, whereby great teamwork can lead to a heroic save or a total disaster.

With its simple, accessible controls and vibrant, stylized art style, FiresOut! is easy to pick up yet endlessly replayable with your friends. Grab your gear, a few trusted comrades, and dive right into the chaos in this firefighting frenzy where every second counts, and cooperation is the only way to save the neighborhood.

Rescue The Neighborhood!

  • Coordinate Together To Move The Fire Extinguish, Mr Glug Glug

  • Overcome environmental challenges

  • Extinguish the fire

  • Rescue the victims

  • Be a hero!.. Or atleast try to be one

Chaotic Couch Coop Fun

Work together to battle spreading fires, dodge fireballs, and rescue victims in a frantic race against fiery chaos. Juggle tasks, make split-second decisions, and turn teamwork into either heroic victories or hilarious disasters!

Fire Monster Chaos

The fire monster doesn’t wait! It throws fireballs around the house, constantly reshaping the environment, blocks your path, lit up the houses on fire and disrupt your strategy.

Adorable Victims & Playable Characters 

Not every rescue is the same! From panicked residents to distressed aliens all the way to victims trapped in volcano, each type of victim reacts differently and forces you to adapt your strategy on the fly. Along the way, unlock and play as a cast of cute animal firefighter interns, each bringing charm (and chaos) to your firefighting adventures.

Chaotic Neighborhood with Unique Challenges

From your very own neighborhood to a dangerous Toy Factory and slippery Ice Castle all the way to a fiery Lava castle as well as a spaceship, each world throws a brand-new twist into the chaos. Every neighborhood introduces its own unique mechanics and hazards, forcing you and your crew to rethink your strategy, adapt on the fly, and master firefighting in wildly different environments.

Play Couch Coop Style, Online or Locally

Whether you’re sitting side by side on the same couch or connecting with friends across the internet, FiresOut! keeps the spirit of true couch co-op alive along with support for controllers. Share laughs, shout at each other, and celebrate your chaotic victories no matter where you play.

Do you have what it takes to become a certified firefighting intern heroes? Or will your friendship and trust go up in flames first?
